prerequisites: has basic knowledge from range of characteristic and properties of hazardous physical agents (electric energy, mechanical vibrations, lighting, electromagnetic field, dusts), chemical and biological agents.
has systematical knowledge from range of mathematics, physics, chemistry and informatics.

learning_outcomes.text: Acquirement of basic knowledge from areas of labor law, as well as work accidents and occupational diseases
Acquirement of basic knowledge from areas of ergonomics and labor biomechanics
Acquirement of basic knowledge from analysis and protection before dangerous, harmful and strenuous factors in work environment
It knows basic regulations and standards of work safety
It has basic knowledge from ergonomics area and it is conscious for capability of its practical application in designing and manufacturing of products
It knows basic threats at work stands and methods of protection before them.

syllabus_topics: Labor protection, work safety regulations and principles
Accidents at work and occupational diseases, estimate of professional risk on work positions
Labor biomechanics - science about threats for employee health discovering, being result of executable work
Dangerous and harmful agents in work environment - mechanical agents and electric power
Dangerous and harmful agents in work environment - noise, vibrations and lighting
Dangerous and harmful agents in work environment - chemical and biological agents
teaching_methods: traditional lecture with the use of transparencies and slides
self study - self studies and preparation for examination
assessment_rules: The final grade (P) is equal to the score from the forming evaluation (F1).
bibliography: CIOP - Science about work - safety, sanitation, ergonomics, CIOP, Warsaw 2000
B. Rączkowski - Industrial Safety in practice - BHP, ODDK, Gdansk 2012
D. Idczak - Ergonomics as forming of work conditions
L. Skuza - Accidents at work from A to Z
degree: Mechanical Engineering and Machine Building (I level, full-time)
